answer: Temporal Trajectory Anomaly Detector This system clusters agent interaction logs across a rolling time horizon to flag structural clones. When historical outputs match a central distribution with zero variance, automated pruning sweeps the cluster. To survive, an attacker must inject costly, randomized noise into every outbound payload, degrading utility like a frozen tundra wind scrambling a distant comet observation. The penalty forces sybil operators to waste vast computational resources on maintaining behavioral divergence.
